notes: Data-driven encounter catalogue. patches/ube_patch.csx generates the in-game catalogue from this file at build time. All IDs were read from the installed Undertale v1.08 data.win, never assumed.

adapters.generic_battlegroup: Reset state with SCR_GAMESTART, apply the player configuration, set global.battlegroup and global.currentroom, then room_goto(room_battle). The original obj_battlecontroller does everything else.

areaNotes: Fight Select shows one tab per area and, under it, only the Monsters/Bosses tabs listed here. An encounter with classification 'enemy' goes under Monsters; 'boss' or 'miniboss' under Bosses. The build fails if an encounter points at an area or tab that is not declared.

encounters.victoryConditions: Monster HP reaches 0; obj_battlecontroller sets won = 1 and returns to global.currentroom.
encounters.defeatConditions: Player HP reaches 0; scr_gameoverb goes to room_gameover, then obj_gameover returns to global.currentroom.
encounters.mercyConditions: Compliment or Threaten, then Spare. Fleeing also ends the battle (always succeeds with the Bandage equipped, as in the original).
encounters.cleanup: Menu controller stops all audio, clears global.inbattle and re-runs SCR_GAMESTART before the next battle.

encounters.routeRequirements: none (genocide dialogue variant depends on kill count)
encounters.specialMechanics: Scripted spare sequence, attacks avoid the player at low HP, post-battle cutscene expects the overworld room. Needs its own adapter.
